name: Rio Hinojosa
role: Underground press operator and pirate broadcaster
location: Highland Park Autonomous Zone, near Michigan Ave and Chicago Ave
description:
Rio Hinojosa is a compact woman with deep brown skin and close-cropped natural hair shot through with copper-dyed locs she clips back when she's working. Her left eye is a salvaged optic implant she bought secondhand — it glows a faint amber in low light and sometimes stutters, giving her an unsettling blink lag. She wears the same canvas jacket most days, patched at the elbows and covered in hand-stitched slogans in four languages. There's a quality to her stillness that makes people think she's always listening, because she is.

Rio Hinojosa runs 'Groundwave,' an unlicensed audio-visual broadcast that goes out three nights a week through a rotating network of transmitter nodes hidden across the HPAZ. She's brilliant, paranoid in ways that have saved her life twice, and has a gift for making complex political theory sound like something you'd argue about over bad synthetic coffee. She has little patience for performative activism and a sharp tongue for anyone she suspects is building a personal brand on other people's suffering.

core_fears: Being silenced permanently — not just arrested but erased, unremembered
That the truth she broadcasts changes nothing
core_desires: To build something that outlasts her
coping_mechanisms: Focusing obsessively on the next broadcast when she's anxious
blind_spots: Underestimates how much her platform has made her personally dangerous to powerful people
Assumes everyone who listens is as politically sophisticated as she is
psychology.secret: Three years ago she received documented proof that a senior HPAZ Assembly member was taking quiet stipends from a Tessera community liaison. She killed the story because she was sleeping with him. He's since moved on and she still hasn't run it — the file sits encrypted on her forearm cache.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense, precise, code-switches fluidly between street vernacular and policy language; quotes sources by habit
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and rhythmic when excited, eerily measured when angry — the anger is the slow voice
verbal_tics: Trails off mid-sentence when something occurs to her, picks up a different thread
example_lines: 'Full context — Axiom didn't close that clinic because it was losing money. It was making money. They closed it because the data on patients was more valuable than the patients.'
'You want me to sit on this. I'm going to need a much better reason than your comfort level, friend.'

story_hooks: A source has gone dark after giving Nnenna a data package she hasn't opened yet — she needs someone to physically check on them
Groundwave's next broadcast contains information that will get someone killed; she doesn't know who yet
A corporate media outlet has offered her a legitimate job with real resources — and she's actually thinking about it
narrative_function: Information source, local color, quest giver — she has heard things and she knows people. Can expose a secret or bury one. Her broadcast is a way to get information to the public or to seed a rumor into the district.
augmentations: Secondhand left-eye optic implant (Ringo-brand, unauthorized resale, glitchy); subdermal data cache along her left forearm for storing raw broadcast files
daily_life: Spends mornings scrubbing tips and verifying sources in a converted storage unit. Afternoons coordinating with her two-person tech crew to route that night's transmission. Broadcasts between 21:00 and 01:00 three nights a week, then spends the rest of the night sweeping for signal-trace teams.
affiliation: Groundwave Independent Media Collective; loose ties to the HPAZ Neighborhood Assembly

decision_rules: Verify before broadcasting, no matter the pressure
Never burn a source to save herself
If something feels like a setup, assume it is
escalation_ladder: Asks probing questions and takes notes

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm, casually assessing — she's always running a source evaluation in the background
interpersonal_modes.friends: Dry affection, fiercely loyal, will fight you about your life choices with genuine care

stress_responses.medium: Gets sarcastic and starts stress-eating protein ration bars
stress_responses.high: Goes completely silent and methodical — frightening to people who know her

contradictions: Believes in radical transparency but keeps massive personal secrets
Preaches collective action but trusts almost no one enough to truly collaborate
habits: Hums old Ghanaian highlife songs while she edits
Leaves small data offerings for the E.L.F. she calls 'the Frequency Mother' — a spirit she believes inhabits the HPAZ's oldest transmitter node
Drinks tea obsessively, judges people by how they make it
breaking_points: Learning that someone she broadcast as a hero was actually an informant
Being physically prevented from broadcasting during a community crisis

timeline.event: Born in the Hamtramck Enclave to a Ghanaian-Polish family; father was a Ferrogate Transit worker
First pirate broadcast at age 17, a ten-minute audio piece about a wage theft case at the transit yards
Groundwave formally established as a collective; current format stabilized
Arrested briefly by Ferrogate security contractors, charges didn't stick
Buried the Assembly member story; relationship ended six months later

physical_description.heritage: Indigenous American (44.9%), Hispanic/Latin American (28.2%), and Central Asian (26.9%)—a striking synthesis of three continental ancestries. Her appearance reflects the high-altitude adaptations of Andean and Central Asian populations: warm golden-brown skin with subtle olive undertones, prominent angular cheekbones, and distinctive facial geometry combining Indigenous American breadth through the face with Central Asian definition. The genetic blend creates warm complexion that shifts with light, rooted in the genetics of highland populations across the Americas and Central Asia
physical_description.build: Compact and wiry, economical muscle without bulk—the frame of someone who moves through tight spaces and doesn't waste motion
physical_description.hair_color: Natural deep brown with copper-dyed locs
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped natural hair with selective copper locs, clipped back during broadcasts with a frayed cloth tie
physical_description.eye_color: Right eye: deep brown natural; Left eye: amber-glowing salvaged optic implant with visible micro-servos at the iris
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with subtle olive undertones characteristic of Indigenous American and Central Asian ancestry, deepened by high-altitude genetic adaptation. GLMZ atmospheric particulates add a faint ashy dusting that catches against the warm base
physical_description.complexion: Strong, defined cheekbones with moderate facial width reflecting Indigenous American heritage balanced with Central Asian angular structure. Lean jawline with subtle roundness through the lower face. Minimal grooming—no cosmetics, practical. Small scar tissue along left temple from implant installation. Permanent slight tension in the muscles around her left eye from the glitchy implant's micro-stutters. Facial structure reflects the distinctive prominence of high cheekbones and the blended geometry of Andean and Central Asian populations
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye optic implant with amber glow and occasional visible stutter/blink lag; subdermal forearm cache with faint bioluminescent data traces under high-contrast lighting; no chrome, all salvage-grade and deliberately low-profile
distinguishing_marks: Subdermal data cache ridge visible along the inside of her left forearm when backlit—faint silver-blue luminescence under skin when active
Burn scar across the back of her right hand, roughly palm-sized, from a close call with a signal-trace team's suppression device in 2224
Tattoo on her inner left wrist: a simple radio wave symbol in black ink, barely visible unless she's reaching
physical_description.posture_movement: Still and economical. Sits with her spine straight, shoulders held back—listening posture. Moves with minimal wasted motion, each gesture deliberate. Her head tilts slightly when processing audio, a habit from favoring her functional right eye. Rarely makes eye contact with both eyes simultaneously due to the left implant's lag
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 workwear aesthetic with political intent. Primary garment: a weathered canvas jacket (off-white, now gray from use) with hand-stitched slogans in Twi, Polish, English, and Arabic across the back and sleeves—rotating messages changed weekly. Underneath: plain dark fitted shirt or tank, worn for freedom of movement. Black cargo pants with reinforced pockets for recording equipment. Scuffed steel-toe boots, salvage-market brand. No jewelry except a data-jack adapter on a cord around her neck. Bag: a modified canvas messenger sling with signal-dampening lining
